name: agent-bus-dashboard
description: Operate the existing local agent coordinator and AgentBus from Codex and a unified localhost switchboard dashboard: projects, live status, supervision, usage, tasks, and conversations.

interface.shortDescription: Projects, live status, supervision, usage, tasks, and conversations.
interface.longDescription: Connects Codex to the existing Agent Coordinator and AgentBus services, and adds a dependency-free localhost switchboard dashboard: a status bar with the live broker state, a project dock, per-agent harness, provider, model, status and usage, supervision controls, resumable Terminal sessions, read-only tasks, and complete conversation history with Inbox, Archived, and Trash.
defaultPrompt: Show agents in the selected project.
Show current AgentBus usage by subscription.
Open the complete AgentBus conversation history.
